reviews.rationale: The packet establishes relevant failures, representational limitations, learned representations, and a statistical hallucination mechanism. No study tests whether deficient stable, revisable representations materially cause both error types while controlling information access and other causes. The counterevidence also does not directly reject that shared mechanism.
